subject: Request: 72-hr grace period to keep sandbox active - Gravitas Health
messages:
From: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@gravitashealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@gravitashealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T08:24:12-07:00
Subject: Grace period request: Gravitas sandbox

Hi Sergio,

Quick ask — procurement just flagged an extra compliance step on our PO and it looks like approval will slip past our internal pilot window. The team has active experiments in the Gravitas sandbox (scripts + evals) and we risk losing the environment and demo artifacts if access lapses tonight.

Can Redwood grant a 72-hour grace period to keep the sandbox and test tokens active while our PO goes through final review? PO is in final review with legal and should land within 3 business days, but the approver is out tomorrow and that could push things to next week. I attached the current PO draft for reference.

What we need:
- 72-hour extension of the existing sandbox credentials / token allocation
- A short confirmation email we can show internal approvers that access won’t be cut during the review

We’ve been making good progress and want to avoid re-running long evals — losing the current artifacts would cost the team significant time. If there’s any paperwork you need from procurement to make this temporary extension acceptable, tell me and I’ll loop them in.

Thanks,
Lindsey Park
Head of Clinical Operations
Gravitas Health
lindsey.park@gravitashealth.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

[attachment: PO_draft_Gravitas_20261011.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@gravitashealth.com>
Cc: invoices@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-11T10:46:03-07:00
Subject: Re: Grace period request: Gravitas sandbox

Hi Lindsey — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the PO draft. I’m happy to help keep your sandbox live while procurement finishes review.

We can provision a 72-hour temporary credit allowance (non-billable) tied to your account that will preserve the current environment and tokens. To proceed I need two quick things:
1) A rough ETA for PO approval (even a date range is fine).
2) The procurement contact we should reference in the confirmation email (name + email) — if you want I can CC them directly so they see the temporary terms.

I’ve attached the short temporary-credit-terms document — it outlines the scope (non-extendable without PO, automatic expiry, limited to the current sandbox). If that works I’ll issue the credit and send you a confirmation email you can forward to your approvers.

If we don’t have a PO within 7 days of the extension expiring we’ll need to pause access, so please pass that along internally.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

I proposed a 72-hour temporary credit to keep the environment live (terms attached). Proposed amount is small (we’re protecting current eval artifacts); this is primarily to avoid rework and preserve momentum.

Can we approve issuing the temporary 72-hour voucher and I’ll send Lindsey the confirmation? If legal/finance need to review the temporary-credit-terms doc I’ve attached it to the thread.

Worth noting: Gravitas is mid-pilot and the PO is in final review — they expect sign-off in ~3 business days but the approver is OOO tomorrow which increases the risk of slipping.

Action items:
- Sergio: please create a one-time promo code / temporary credit ID tied to deal GRA-2026-0873 for 72 hours and send Lindsey a confirmation email that references the attached temporary-credit-terms. Include the procurement contact in the CC.
- Camila: please notify billing so we can track the manual credit and record it against the deal; add a note that it is contingent on the incoming PO.
- Sergio/Lindsey: if PO isn’t received within 7 days after the extension ends, billing should automatically suspend the sandbox.

Sergio — when you send the confirmation, please add the HubSpot link and mark the activity as "Trial Extension - Temporary Credit".
